verdict.rationale: Render ships several fixed event-driven automations: auto-deploy on every push, ephemeral previews for every change, and load-based autoscaling. Workspace webhooks can notify external systems on service events such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down, and workflow tasks can be triggered from code. However, there is no evidence of a user-definable rules engine; custom event→action logic requires wiring webhooks or SDK code to your own handlers. Missing for 10: native user-defined trigger/condition/action rules, documented event filtering/conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
